lines.en: I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and prepare myself for yet another free vacation.
Just, this time, it’s for the very specific purpose of reminding one of our friends that she is supposed to be horny all the time — which she currently is not.

Is this as big of a problem as Haruka seems to think it is? Probably not. But, then again, this is Maki we’re talking about. And I’m not sure she’s had any time off ever since the whole husband thing happened.
Plus, things have been pretty crazy for me lately as well. So maybe I could use a bit of rest and relaxation too?
I say that fully aware that this will somehow wind up either depressing, extremely sexual, or just not relaxing at all.
But hey, it’s worth a shot.
: Mm...what do you want? It’s 7:00 AM...
: So what? Aren’t you usually going to work around this time?
: Aren’t you usually sleeping around this time?...
: Not when I know there’s a free trip still hanging in limbo.
: What?...
: Get dressed, Haruka. It’s vacation time.
: Mngh...five more minutes...
: Fine. I’ll call Maki in the meantime and let her know what’s going on.
: Wait-
I hang up the phone and dial Maki’s number. I hope she’s prepared to regain her libido.
: Hey.
: Hey.
: Is it boner time?
: It’s boner time.
: I’ll pack my bag.
Well, that was easier than I expected it to be.
I guess all that’s left now is to wait for Haruka to get ready and...figure out where the three of us are going to meet up.
Both of them drive so I’m sure that one of them will wind up swinging by to pick me up, but-
Never mind.
It’ll be fine.
I need to focus on relaxing.
As predicted, Haruka shows up a couple hours later with Maki already in tow and the three of us set course to...wherever it is we’re going. I’m still not really sure.
I decided against packing anything since I can always just sleep naked and...also wanted to avoid Ami noticing some of my things are missing as I’m sure she takes inventory of my possessions nightly.
Haruka drives slower than Maki — almost like she’s been made aware of how fidgety I can be in places like this.
And I’m sure the one who informed her is the same one listening to podcasts with her feet up in the back of the car right now.
Either way, this will be over before I know it and we’ll all have a great time turning each other on or whatever it is we’re supposed to be doing today.
I haven’t forgotten, it’s just a little harder to fully remember when I’m so focused on the clouds shadowing us from behind the trees.
: You good?
: Why do you ask?
: You’ve been tapping your foot ever since I picked you up. And I’m pretty sure it’s not to the soothing sounds of the Joe Rogan Show leaking out of Maki’s AirPods.
I am apparently a bit less discreet about my discomfort than I thought.
: I’m good. You don’t have to worry about me.
: Of course I have to worry about you.
: Even if the main purpose of this trip is to fix Maki, it doesn’t mean that’s what it’s all about.
: You’re my friend. And if there’s one thing I’ve learned about myself lately, it’s that I don’t always put you guys first when I probably should.
: Can you save your character development until we’re out of the car, please?
: Hm? Did somebody say something? Because if somebody said something, I didn’t hear it. I’m listening to the Joe Rogan Show on my AirPods.
: Yes, Maki. We know. Go back to listening to the Joe Rogan Show on your AirPods.
: Okay. I’m going to go back to listening to the Joe Rogan Show on my AirPods now.
: I feel like there’s some kind of joke here I’m not getting.
: And I feel like now is the perfect time for character development since Maki is listening to the Joe Rogan Show on her AirPods.
: Listen, we’ve known each other for a while now, haven’t we?
: I mean...I guess. Yeah.
: And within that time I have made out with you behind my husband’s back, hid it from Sara, turned everyone’s problems into my own, and then abandoned Maki when she needed me most.
: I’ve been kind of a bitch. We don’t have to pretend I haven’t been. I get that now. But that’s exactly why I’m trying to kind of, like...turn things around. And think of other people for once.
: I’ve never been great at that, but it’s not because I don’t care about you guys or anything. I’ve just always...put myself first, I guess.
: I don’t think there’s any harm in that, Haruka.

: Yeah, well you’re not the one trying to turn things around. I am. So don’t say stuff like, “You don’t have to worry about me,” because it like, totally goes against everything I’ve been telling myself lately.
: This trip’s for you guys, not me. Well, it’s mostly for Maki. And it was originally for Maki and Sara. But you’re a suitable replacement.
: I’m not sure if you’ll attract as many people as she would, though. Even with the penis. Sara’s kind of popular with the younger crowds and gets stared at a lot.
: Probably because she blends in with them.

: Probably. I’m too busy also staring to really figure that out, but that doesn’t matter now. What matters is having a relaxing day and then leaving this place tomorrow feeling refreshed and reinvigorated.
: And in Maki’s case, horny. Hopefully.
: You really think just getting a day off at some fancy resort is going to be enough to set her back on track?
: No.
: But I think it’s a start.
: And a “start” never hurt anybody.
Somewhere along the way, the tapping of my left foot stops.
I do not alternate to my right- and I do not compensate by tapping my other limbs instead.
I simply focus on the clouds and the trees that try to hide them.
Soon enough, they’ll run out of cover.
And soon enough, so will I.
Haruka and Maki waste no time at all when it comes to changing into their swimsuits and I wind up meeting up with them after renting one that looks eerily similar to the one I have at home.
Also, I’m sure it goes without saying, but if the objective of this trip was to get me horny, we could probably just pack up and head home now because wow.
Though, I guess it’s possible I just spend so much time around girls who have barely outgrown training bras that seeing two fully developed women at once just gets to me, you know?
But I digress as this is the part of the day where I squeeze my way into a conversation that would best be left between two girls.
Or rather, two best friends — as I might be a replacement for Sara, but I will never be a replacement for Sara.

: Is there anything in particular you want to do today? I got massages lined up for the two of us a few hours from now. And we’ve got dinner reservations at 5:00. But if there’s anything else, just tell me.
: You’re really going all out, huh? You’ve never splurged on me like this before. And I’d know because I’ve been splurged on by at least like, twenty guys. Probably more.
: That second splurge was supposed to be “splooge.”
: Like, cum. I’m saying at least twenty guys have came on me. And you are currently...financially cumming on me. Or something.
: You done?
: Yeah, sorry. My heart’s just not in it right now.
: That’s fine. There’s no need to rush or anything. We can take it one hour at a time.
: But also know that I won’t hold it against you if you start returning to normal halfway through the trip and want to run off with Sensei for a little fun.
: I’m good, but thanks.
: Wow, okay.
: Are you suuuuure? Not even the tip? Because the tip doesn’t count.
: I don’t think it works that way.
: I’m an authority on the subject and I can confirm that Haruka is right. The tip doesn’t count. It’s shaft or nothing.
: Okay then. Maybe it works that way after all and I’m just behind on the times.
: Yeah...something tells me neither one of us thinks that’s going to happen.
: What happens at fancy resorts stays at fancy resorts. I won’t tell anyone.
: I...don’t think that’s the problem here.
: Maki, come on! What’s with that expression? Lighten up a little! Go flirt with randoms and...ego-surf or something. There are plenty of people around here who’d be happy to hit on you.
: Am I supposed to go around and flirt with people or lean back and relax? You’re pushing me in multiple directions and I’m not sure which one will get me closer to you being a little less...Haruka.
: Maki, all I want is for you to get back to your normal self. It hurts all of us seeing you so...blah all the time.
: I’m not even “blah,” though. I’m just...not as interested in sex anymore.
: But why? Sex is awesome. You love sex. I love sex. Everybody loves sex.
: If sex is so good, how come there’s no sex 2?
: What?
: Yeah, what?
: What I’m saying is...if you love sex so much, why don’t you just marry it?
: Again, what? Also, I’m already married.
: Wow. Rub it in, why don’t you?
: Maki...
: Haruka, if you want to leave me behind to go “flirt with randoms” and be all sexual and stuff, more power to you. Go for it. I always thought you’d be better off in an open marriage anyway.
: That way, you could still hang out with your buddies Sex 1 and Sex 2 and be totally guilt-free about it.
: You know a lot of people just view that as cheating though, right?
: A lot of people view cheating as cheating too and that hasn’t stopped you yet.
: Oof.
: And a lot of people think pineapple belongs on pizza. That doesn’t mean they’re right. It means they have a stupid fucking opinion and the world would be better without them.

: I’m glad that sort of thing works for you, I’m just...I’m not really sure it would work for me personally. Nor do I think I can just convert the relationship to “open” while my husband is fighting aliens.
: It'd make more sense to just...end the marriage altogether, I think.
: Haruka, for all we know, he might be fucking aliens. Which, again, would be totally cool if your marriage was open.
: I bet Masahiro fucked at least one alien before he died. I know I would’ve. Well, back when I was still horny, at least. Right now, there might be a little...conflict in terms of getting it in.
: Unless alien dicks are self-lubricating. Which they might be. We don’t really know. But I hope they are. Or were. For Masahiro’s sake.
: As good a saleswoman as you are, I’m not sure if open marriages are the sort of thing you should be peddling onto other people when they’re most definitely not for all of us.
: But they should be because sex and love don’t always have to be linked. Sometimes, you just want to try something different. And don’t pretend for a second you don’t.
: I’m not “pretending” anything. It’s perfectly normal to fantasize about stuff. It’s only wrong once you actually act on it.

: Then what’s the problem at this point? You two are already having sex. And cool, friend-sex at that. Wouldn’t it be better if that was just allowed rather than something you have to feel guilty about?
: “Wrong” is subjective. There’s no definitive right or wrong when it comes to stuff like love and sex. It’s not, like...murder or something. It’s way simpler than that.
: I thought the whole open marriage thing was your husband’s idea, wasn’t it?
: Just because it was his idea doesn’t mean I can’t like it as well, does it?
: I think it was great for us in a bunch of ways, and that it would be great for a lot of other people as well if they could overlook the stigmas surrounding it.
: Either way, it’s too late to just change now. That would have had to be something we talked about beforehand.
: Maybe you already did? Your husband had no problem with me fucking you. Who’s saying he wouldn’t have budged if somebody else wanted to as well?
: Can we go back to talking about you now? I’ve somehow become the target of this and I’m not quite sure how or why.
: The why is because you’ve been pushing my buttons nonstop lately and I wanted to push yours for a minute or two as revenge. The how is kind of self-explanatory.
: You really think I’ve been pushing your buttons?
: Yes. But I know you’re doing it out of love this time, so that makes it kind of okay.
: Honestly, I know this whole no-horny thing is probably shocking to both of you. But I don’t think a one day vacation or flirting with young people is going to fix that.
: What about a fancy dinner? Or wine? Or a fancy dinner with wine? Or a sensual massage from an androgynous therapist with extremely strong hands?
: That last one does sound nice. But that might just be because I’m old and my back hurts all the time.
: Your back hurts? Give me a break. Like a third of my body weight is latched onto my chest and trying to pull me down all day.
: Yes, but I have probably spent significantly more time in strange sex positions than you have. And those can take a toll on a woman.
: Fair.
: You can have it your way once we leave the resort. I’ll stop pestering you about stress levels and the reclamation of your libido and just...let you do your own thing.
: But for the rest of today, I’d be happy if you humored me by coming along for all of the stuff I planned. Or, at the very least, just trying to relax in some form.
: I’ve been trying to do that since we sat down and you made it weird by telling me to go fuck our other friend.
: I didn’t tell you to fuck him. I said I’d be okay with you fucking him. Which I am.
: Thank you for the clarification. Boner time is over. Nap time is now.
: Hi. “Other friend” here. What am I supposed to do while the two of you sit there with your eyes closed?
: Go flirt with randoms since Maki won’t and I made the apparent mistake of not opening my marriage.
: Right. And if I can’t find anyone else to have sex with while you’re taking a nap?
: Then you can go schedule a massage like I did for Maki and me and hope that your masseuse offers those kinds of services.
: But please be advised that one of us was already kicked out for asking that once.
: We will never tell you which one it was.
: I’m...not sure I even want to know.
Maki’s affection has increased to [maki_love]!
Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!
